# Optional fund-research profile

Version: 1.0.0. Adapted from the author's fund-first scoring method, without private baselines, observations, or publication permissions.

Define the actual fund scope before evaluating: ETF, mutual fund, index/active, bond, money market, gold, QDII and portfolios only where requested. Macroeconomics serves the fund decision; a stock valuation terminal is not automatically required.

Independently inspect source/date, NAV and total-return treatment, fees, shares/amounts, currencies, cash conservation, look-through overlap and unknown disclosure coverage. Distinguish deterministic calculation correctness from whether the model actually consumed the inputs and used the calculation correctly. Delivery and history recovery prove mechanisms, not research quality or investment return.

Keep user value separate from technical maturity. Unknown real-task denominator means unknown success rate. Synthetic weekly fixtures are not natural weeks. No claim of alpha, legal compliance or professional suitability without the corresponding evidence. Do not read private positions or perform model calls merely to score.
